annotations.title: Cancel a copy of old mail

description: Cancel a copy of old mail. It stops after the step our team is running, if one is: a copy step that didn't report back is still checked, and the last copy is still read back, so everything copied stays checked (`next.reason` is `stopping` until then, and `cancelRequestedAt` is set). Mail already copied stays in the new mailbox. Nothing is deleted on either server, no login changes back and the MX record stays as it is. A copy cancelled past its switch of logins leaves the mailbox paused: resume it with resume_mailbox once the MX record points at our server, or once its logins point back at the old one. A copy already cancelled answers as it is, and one done or stopped answers 409 `migrationEnded`. resume_mailbox_migration takes a cancel back.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.
